issues.on_page: Local Receipts: In Lieu of Tax 77,106.00 (Enterprise Fund column)
issues.issue: Under the rules, in-lieu of tax goes to 'other taxes'. But this is 98% of the Enterprise Fund's receipts, and no water, sewer or solid waste charges are printed even though the fund spends 102,670 on those utilities. Utility charges may have been entered on the wrong form line. Already marked review.

Line 35 is split by fund column. The column amounts are printed, so they aren't computed, but these items have no split_from (the rules call for one on rows split by column). The fund name was also added to the printed label. Same for disbursements[3].
